section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a laboratory study examining the incremental predictive validity of trait-based and domain mental toughness on learning and performance outcomes, including adaptive performance. It found no relationships between trait-based mental toughness and learning criteria, but domain mental toughness explained variance in self-efficacy and performance, and was indirectly related to adaptive performance. Goal orientation was mentioned as a control variable.
